sections.heading: Watch the workout as selected footage
paragraphs: The video contains three retained shooting sequences from an individual indoor workout. Original on-screen training captions remain visible. Watch the complete edit once before comparing shots so you can distinguish the basketball action, the source captions and the added HoopCut trail.

sections.heading: Compare one feature per replay
paragraphs: On one replay, look for the last dribble or gather. On another, follow the ball after release. Trying to assess footwork, balance and ball flight at once makes it easy to confuse different moments. Use neutral observations rather than treating three selected shots as a representative performance sample.

sections.heading: Keep the example in scope
